item.title: Agent Win — Mark Heath
item.description:
Mark Heath made his first JLT booking on 1st July 2025. A year on, he has passed £200,000 in gross holiday sales.
Sixty-three bookings, and his year-one target reached three weeks early… all built alongside a full-time job that already runs around 55 hours a week. The late nights, early mornings and weekends are right there in the numbers.
His goal was a simple one: enough commission to fund his own family holidays. This summer he is taking the kids to Walt Disney World in Orlando, paid for by the business he has built.
Consistency, not luck. That is what building a travel business within JLT looks like.
Congratulations Mark… richly deserved.
